data.body: Investigation complete (investigation-only mode). Root cause confirmed: test asserts too broadly — bans ALL dso:* subagent_type values, but AGENTS.md permits named-primary dispatch for registered agents. Failing files: sprint/SKILL.md (dso:gov-copy-writer, dso:completion-verifier, dso:verification-remediation-planner) and epic-scrutiny-pipeline.md (dso:feasibility-reviewer). All four agents are registered in AGENTS.md with agent files in plugins/dso/agents/ and have documented fallback to general-purpose. Fix: update assert_no_invalid_subagent_type() to allowlist registered agent names. Envelope written to scratch key fix-bug:investigation.
